messages:
Anya Patel: Hey everyone! I’m Anya — excited to join Redwood Inference as a PM for Private deployments. Looking forward to meeting folks and learning the ropes :wave:
Migs Rivera: welcome Anya!! :tada: where are you based?
Anya Patel: SF-based, but remote-first. love hiking and spicy food. happy to hop on intro calls this week.
Devon Li: welcome! quick icebreaker: favorite late-night snack? chips / chocolate / fruit / nuts
Oliver Chen: chips all the way :potato: also free for a 15m intro today 3pm PT if that works
Rebecca Young: welcome Anya!! FYI onboarding doc here: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/onboarding (will DM you access). we’ll have your laptop ready by monday :computer:
hr-bot: Welcome Anya! Please complete the new hire paperwork: https://hr.redwood/forms/new-hire (deadline: 3 business days)
Migs Rivera: also — team lunch on Friday? proposing 12:30 for anyone in-office :pizza:
Anya Patel: count me in if others are going! any recommendations for coffee near the office?
Oliver Chen: Bluebird Coffee on 5th is my go-to. also appreciate a good cortado at Night Owl.
Devon Li: poll update: chips 3, chocolate 1 — unofficial Slack poll concluded :stuck_out_tongue_closed_eyes:
Rebecca Young: adding you to the #private-deploys channel and calendar invites. welcome aboard again :heart:
